blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The legal representatives of drug war victims expressed their support for the prosecution’s request before the International Criminal Court (ICC) to allow their witnesses to use pseudonyms as well as to testify in closed sessions. In a 10-page submission published on the ICC website on Thursday, the Common Legal Representatives of the Victims (CLRV) submitted their response to prosecution’s Nov. 5 request for protective and special measures for 55 of its witnesses.
